description: Independent adversarial/negative eval corpus for RSTF. Unlike benchmark/rstf/corpus.json, these examples are NOT generated by calling api/semantic_fingerprint.py's encode_* helpers — they are hand-authored or drawn from publicly known reference examples, so this eval is not circular with respect to the detector's own tables. It also includes negative controls (legitimate non-English and edge-case Latin text) that the detector must NOT flag, which the original 160-example benchmark never tested because its corpus was 100% English ASCII.
